subject.title: [Feature]: Discord thread-reply mention gate — respond to thread starter freely, require mention for follow-up replies

question: Should Discord add an opt-in autoThread follow-up mention gate, and should its public API be Slack-style thread.requireExplicitMention or a per-channel requireMentionInThreadReplies option?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix adds public Discord config surface and changes which thread replies reach the agent, so automation should not choose the permanent API or default semantics.

options.title: Add explicit follow-up gate
options.body: Introduce a default-off Discord option that requires explicit mentions for follow-up replies while preserving current autoThread behavior for existing users.

options.title: Fold into parent/thread override
options.body: Resolve this only as part of the broader parent-versus-thread requireMention design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/75938, accepting that starter-versus-follow-up semantics may need extra rules.

options.title: Keep current continuation
options.body: Decline new Discord config surface and document that bot-owned autoThreads intentionally continue without mentions after the starter message.

recommendation.title: Add explicit follow-up gate
recommendation.body: Introduce a default-off Discord option that requires explicit mentions for follow-up replies while preserving current autoThread behavior for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across shared mention policy and Discord preflight routing, and the decision crosses channel policy plus config compatibility.
